_meta.task: Task 7: Domain-intake JSON + resynthesis script + full hermetic smoke

program.name: Lead Research Agent
intake.purpose: Find purpose-relevant leads and contacts across configured public web sources. The program fans out over configured sources, performs guarded bounded navigation only through WebNavigationHostConnector, extracts leads against the configured extraction_schema, aggregates and dedupes records, persists them cross-session through PersistenceHostConnector, and renders a PDF report through PdfReportHostConnector.
